source: drive-foldkit-examples integration-3, 2026-11-01T03:55Z: Charting fetchJson curried arrows and named toChartMountError/toMapMountError; Map and WebSocket explicit Effect.callback<T, Error>

cases.name: curried-arrow-handler
cases.before:
import { Effect } from "effect"
export const load = (prefix: string) => (n: number): Effect.Effect<number, Error> => Effect.mapError(Effect.fail(new Error(prefix)), error => new Error(String(error)))
cases.after: export const load = (prefix: string): infer _ => effect (n: number): number!Error => { return (effect { throw new Error(prefix) }) catch effect (error) => { throw new Error(String(error)) } }

cases.name: named-error-mapper
cases.after:
const toError = (e: unknown): Error => new Error(String(e))
export const load = effect (): number!Error => { return try Effect.try({ try: (): number => 1, catch: toError }) }

cases.name: callback-error-type
cases.before:
import { Effect } from "effect"
export const load = () => Effect.callback<number, Error>(resume => { resume(Effect.fail(new Error("x"))) })
cases.after: export const load = effect (): number!Error => { return try Effect.callback<number, Error>((resume): void => { resume(effect { throw new Error("x") }) }) }

cases.name: typed-try-error
cases.before:
import { Effect } from "effect"
export const load = () => Effect.try<number, Error>({ try: () => 1, catch: (cause) => new Error(String(cause)) })
cases.after: export const load = effect (): number!Error => { return try Effect.try<number, Error>({ try: (): number => 1, catch: (cause) => new Error(String(cause)) }) }
